# How much cash stays in your BRRRR deal?

> Free BRRRR calculator for real estate investors. Enter price, rehab, hard-money terms, ARV and refinance terms to see the cash left in the deal, refinance cash-out, cash flow, the highest price that pulls all your cash out, and how a low appraisal or rehab overrun changes it. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
